title: Add shared AI project context

issue.title: TASK-e3b9 Add shared AI project context

description: Create a durable, agent-independent project context document so coding agents can recover important current-state knowledge without relying on transient chat memory.
requirements: Document current architecture, infrastructure, authentication, database, deployment, CI/task workflow, and important product decisions.
Capture recent project decisions and operational lessons that are not fully represented in AGENTS.md.
Clearly distinguish informational context from mandatory rules; AGENTS.md remains authoritative.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue #123 exists with goal and acceptance criteria.
Dedicated task branch task/e3b9-shared-ai-context created from main.
Existing AGENTS.md, README.md, task registry, and task workflow skills reviewed.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/ai-context.md exists and is useful to an independent coding agent.
The document reflects the current repository state and active task areas without inventing implementation details.
Important Supabase Auth, Resend, Vercel, routing, route visibility, pagination, CI, and task-workflow context is recorded.
The document explicitly points agents to AGENTS.md for binding rules.
technicalApproach: Use repository documentation as the durable source of project context.
Summarize current architecture and operational setup from README.md and repository task metadata.
Capture recent project history and known operational lessons from the established project workflow.
definitionOfDone: Relevant documentation checks/build validation pass or are reported if unavailable.
Task metadata records the implementation commit and validation.
Implementation PR targets main and references TASK-e3b9 / Closes #123.

decisionLog.decision: Keep durable project memory in repository documentation rather than relying on ChatGPT conversation memory.
decisionLog.reason: Independent agents and IDE assistants can read the repository; transient conversational memory is not shared across agents.
